4.desc: If the wearer's Break Effect is <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> or higher, the Break DMG dealt to the enemy target ignores <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of their DEF. If the wearer's Break Effect is <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> or higher, the Super Break DMG dealt to the enemy target additionally ignores <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak> of their DEF.
